# QnALog 1.6.4

## Highlights

- New built-in "General" organizing mode (通用). Notes start with an overview; a details section is written only when the overview would otherwise lose facts, so a one-sentence idea gives a short overview and nothing more. When there are several topics, each one appears in the overview.
- New installs default to General, so recording does not need an up-front choice of note type. Other types are still available through "re-organize as…", which creates a derived version and leaves the original untouched.
- The record button now reads "New voice note" (新语音笔记), and the sidebar label "Template" reads "Organizing type" (整理类型).
- General notes follow the transcript's language: Chinese, English, or the transcript's own language for others. Action-item labels are normalized for Chinese and English.
- If a multi-segment General note omits one of the recording's segments, the plugin makes one repair attempt and keeps the first usable draft if that fails.

## User impact

This release does not change the settings schema or API key storage. A saved default mode is not changed; only installs with no saved default start with General. No existing feature is removed. Existing notes are not modified.
